# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Each Test Record contains raw data from analysis of one or more consumer products. If more than one product is analyzed, the product names are separated by a single comma.
3. For each product on each row, please code the Product Analysis Result Code. See below for codes.
4. The spreadsheet should sum the total number of products that failed for each active ingredient (or chemical class/group of similar chemicals) per each test record. The spreadsheet should also sum the total number of products for each active ingredient (or chemical class/group of similar chemicals) that passed per each test record. If spreadsheet sum is zero, put zero.
5. If the active ingredient (or chemical class/group of similar chemicals) records a fail rate greater than 5 percent, document appropriate statistical information in the column below.
